title: Landing page
prompt:
ROLE: Senior brand designer and front-end engineer at a top product studio.
GOAL: A complete, high-converting landing page for [PRODUCT], a [ONE-LINE DESCRIPTION].
AUDIENCE: [TARGET CUSTOMER] deciding in under a minute whether to sign up.
CONTENT & FEATURES:
- Hero: specific headline, one-sentence subhead, primary CTA ([CTA TEXT]) and an illustrative inline-SVG product visual
- Three benefit sections with concrete outcomes (numbers where honest)
- How it works in 3 steps
- Pricing with [PLAN NAMES AND PRICES], monthly/yearly toggle
- FAQ accordion (6 real questions)
- Email capture form with inline validation, success and error states
- Footer with links and a clearly marked sample-content note
DESIGN DIRECTION: A distinctive look drawn from the product's world, not a generic template: one dominant colour, one accent ([ACCENT HEX]), a bold display type scale, generous whitespace.
TECH CONSTRAINTS: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.
ACCESSIBILITY & PERFORMANCE BAR: WCAG 2.2 AA (text contrast 4.5:1, visible focus, labels, landmarks, 24px targets, prefers-reduced-motion); responsive from 360px; fast first paint, no layout shift.
DELIVERABLE FORMAT: One self-contained index.html (inline CSS and JS, no external scripts, no network requests), light and dark themes via prefers-color-scheme, first line "<!-- AI-generated by BrainyApp2; review before publishing -->".
SELF-CHECK BEFORE RETURNING: No lorem ipsum; every button works; form validates; works at 360px and 1440px; both themes readable.
